questions.question:
A developer inspects network traffic and sees this WebSocket upgrade flow. What is the purpose of the Upgrade header in the HTTP handshake?

GET /chat HTTP/1.1
Host: server.example.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: x3JJHMbDL1EzLkh9GBhXDw==

HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade

values: Step 1: Client sends HTTP GET with Upgrade: websocket header
Step 2: Server responds 101 Switching Protocols
Step 3: Protocol switches from HTTP to WebSocket
Step 4: Full-duplex persistent connection established
Step 5: Server can now push data to client without polling

options: Upgrade tells the server to use HTTP/2 instead of HTTP/1.1
Upgrade requests the server to switch from HTTP to a different protocol — here WebSocket — enabling a persistent full-duplex connection
Upgrade is required for all HTTPS requests to enable TLS
Upgrade indicates the client wants to upgrade its browser version
questions.answer: Upgrade requests the server to switch from HTTP to a different protocol — here WebSocket — enabling a persistent full-duplex connection
